RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

An all-male panel that selected a male candidate over a male shortlist tells you nothing about sex discrimination against you. It may say something about the broadcaster's own governance, but raising it as a grievance would read as a misfire and weaken your credibility on the points that actually matter.

Those points are better: the panel's failure to respond to a reasonable request for written reasons after two weeks, and whether "strong experience of digital media" was an advertised, weighted criterion or one introduced late to justify a preferred candidate.

If there is a protected-characteristic angle, it's more plausibly age — eight years' experience versus your fifteen. Chase the written reasons first; they'll tell you which case, if any, you have.
